variants.A: original 4 features, mean pool (reuse verified 600-epoch-search reference)
variants.B: original 4 + duration seconds + turns/second, mean pool
variants.C: original 4, concatenate latent mean and maximum; half-sized downstream hidden layer
variants.D: expanded 6, concatenate latent mean and maximum; half-sized downstream hidden layer

turn_quality: all 205307 selected unique bouts have true original turn/duration flags and nonnegative integer turns; no clipping, imputation or bout removal
people_bouts: exact reference people, visits, selected days/bouts, ranks <=k, folds and 3 draws; no exclusions or label corrections
inner: original 3 person folds; candidate epochs 10..600 step10; choose minimum combined overall person MAE, earlier epoch breaks ties
width: fix per fold/seed/condition to the reference 600-search-selected encoder width (32 or64); do not choose width on test outcomes
head: mean: Linear(width,width/2); meanmax: Linear(2width,width/4); ReLU then scalar output. Parameter counts nearly matched across architecture axis. The architecture change includes pooling AND head-width adjustment.
optimization: unchanged full-batch AdamW lr .01 weight_decay .001, person-weighted SmoothL1 beta .5; train-only person-weighted input/label scaling; no tail label weighting
replication: train draw0, evaluate draw0/1/2 separately; no seed ensemble or draw averaging
criteria: paired overall MAE difference<=0 and tail MAE difference<0; separately assess tail p90/RMSE and all5 seeds. No noninferiority margin. Outer results assess hypotheses, never tune or select epochs.
uncertainty: paired person bootstrap of mean across five seed-specific per-person errors; fixed OOF predictions, not retraining; 3 draws are sensitivity checks, not independent samples
label_sensitivity: evaluate identical trained predictions on unflagged visits only, without replacing primary all-record results
scope: observational ablation within reference-selected widths, not exhaustive architecture optimization or independent final validation; four input summaries plus two gait features, not videos or raw movement sequences
